source_excerpts.text:
Write each Hermitian qubit matrix H=aI+xX+yY+zZ as a four-vector h. Then Tr(HG)=2 h.g and H>=0 iff a>=0 and a^2>=x^2+y^2+z^2. All these tests are rational.

For rational centers Y_i and weights w_i>0 minimize P(E)=sum_i w_i ||E_i-Y_i||_F^2 subject to E_i>=0,sum_i E_i=I. Observed labels have w_i=1; the common unseen aggregate has w_i=1/K. For any Hermitian multiplier L, completion of squares and spectral minimization over the PSD cone give

D(L)=-Tr L+sum_i w_i ||Y_i||_F^2-sum_i Tr[(2w_iY_i-L)_+^2]/(4w_i).

Weak duality gives D(L)<=P_min for every L, without any requirement that an optimizer converged. For V=aI+v.sigma, bound ||v|| between rational lo,hi using integer-square-root bracketing. Upper eigenvalue bounds a+hi and a-lo give an upper bound for the sum of positive-eigenvalue squares and hence a rigorous LOWER dual bound. Interval precision grows with log2 K; no coefficient1/w is dropped.

Primal repair rounds proposal coefficients to dyadics, shifts each scalar component upward by its exact rational spectral-radius upper bound as needed, and divides all effects by c=max(1,lambda_max_upper(sum H_i)). The exact residual I-sum H_i/c is PSD and is added to the final effect. Every returned effect is exactly PSD and their sum is exactly I. A successful result satisfies 0<=P(E)-D_lower(L)<=xi, so P(E)-P_min<=xi. Numerical iteration counts or optimizer statuses are never acceptance evidence.

The singleton case has unique E=I and multiplier L=2w(Y-I), yielding zero gap exactly. In the huge-K proposal only, L is shifted into the PSD cone to prevent a tiny negative dual eigenvalue being multiplied by K. The resulting debit is included in the exact gap. Failure to meet xi raises an exception; no silent tolerance relaxation or successful-status fallback is allowed. Proposal convergence on arbitrary inputs remains unproved.

## Acquisition and scaling boundaries

The learner receives only the actually observed Pauli label and flag-shadow record (plus public horizon/dimensions); it is not given source matrices or the environment state. The source simulator retains and conditions its memory after the actual chosen measurement. Source matrices appear only in simulation and diagnostic scoring. Rational primal repair resets denominators each update rather than recursively multiplying prior repair factors. Certificate integer sizes still depend on input bit length and l

# v3 boundary correction and remaining conditioning failure

2026-10-29. Independent exact verification accepts both frozen v3 boundary certificates in `boundary_certificates_v3.json`; hashes and exact gaps are recorded by `check_boundary_v3.json`. The unchanged dual kernel is used. An exactly feasible center has objective zero; for PSD underloaded seen centers, adding a PSD residual to the default block with dual zero supplies a cheap candidate whose gap remains checked at finite K. The latter positive gap may underflow to displayed float zero; exact rational gap is authoritative.

A separate v2 public-interface test exposes a broader remaining limitation, also inherited by v3: for the previously used overloaded centers, K=2^20,2^30,2^39 all fail closed after the 30,000-iteration Dykstra cap with gaps approximately .5821,.6425,.6426 at requested xi=1e-12. K=2^10 passes at 12,388 iterations. The `K>10^12` routing cutoff bypasses this ill-conditioned regime only at still larger K. Inputs, reproducible program and outcomes are retained in `check_moderate_K_v2.py/.json`. This failure does not affect the accepted recorded banks (K<=16), nor invalidate accepted exact certificates. It rules out describing v3 as a generally reliable finite-call oracle across compressed multiplicities. A direct finite-weight dual mechanism, rather than tolerance relaxation, is a plausible next construction; it has not been established by this review.
